svg.aria-label: Feed publishing in detail: the user's POST goes through a load balancer to web servers that enforce authentication and rate limits. The post service saves the post to the post cache and database. The fanout service 1 gets friend IDs from a graph database, 2 filters them with settings from the user cache (for example muted friends), 3 puts the friend list and post ID on a queue, and 4 fanout workers 5 append post_id, user_id entries to the news feed cache.
svg.title: Feed publishing
